basics.name: Yiwei Zheng
basics.summary: Postdoctoral Researcher at the School of Automation and Intelligent Sensing, Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Research interests include discrete-event systems, formal methods, robotic planning, and information-state-based properties such as safety, security, and opacity.
